messages:
noah_cs: Heads-up from procurement: HelixHealth put onboarding on hold. Their risk team says our vendor form doesn't offer a clear per-tenant opt-out for embeddings when content contains direct identifiers. They need a usable control or a contractual carve-out.

toni_prod: do we have the exact ask?

noah_cs: their message: 
```
Requirement: Customers must be able to prevent permanent storage of vector embeddings generated from any documents that include direct identifiers (SSN, tax id, bank acct, driver license). Evidence of enforcement required for procurement.
```

cal_legal: we can provide a DPA addendum referencing an enforceable technical control + short SOC2-style attestation. we'll need engineering to confirm behavior and a diagram of where embeddings land.

sophia_eng: quick engineering options: (1) API-level opt-out flag to skip persistence for a tenant, (2) scrub PII at ingestion (harder), (3) tenant-scoped ephemeral store with TTL and KMS keys.

noah_cs: which is fastest as a stop-gap the customer can reference? they want something within 8 business days.

sophia_eng: fastest is API opt-out + audit events. Example sanitized example for docs: 
```json
{"persist_embeddings": false, "persist_reason": "procurement-optout"}
```
Server behavior: do not write vectors to persistent DB for that tenant, return ephemeral vectors in the response, and write an immutable audit row (tenant_id, request_id, flag). We can ship behind a feature flag to enterprise tenants in a sprint.

cal_legal: if engineering confirms timeline we will draft addendum and a one-page attestation that maps to SOC2 illustrative control (data retention controls). We also need a data flow snippet showing ephemeral vs persisted paths.

toni_prod: product question: should the opt-out be exposed as a tenant setting only via account ops, or as an API param? exposing as API param has surface risk.

sophia_eng: can do both: enterprise account setting preferred (managed by Account Ops + legal), API param for advanced integrations but restricted by auth scope. We'll document as "enterprise-only" initially.

onboard-bot: ticket ONB-3072 updated: status = blocked by vendor control request; eskew ETA 8 business days.

noah_cs: i'll tell HelixHealth we'll produce an interim technical control (opt-out + audit) and legal addendum draft in 8 business days. Who owns comms and owner for engineering?

sophia_eng: i'll own eng delivery. will create a short PRD and include acceptance tests: (a) request with flag does not persist, (b) audit log entry exists, (c) feature-flag gating.

cal_legal: i'll draft the addendum and the attestation template; will coordinate with SOC2 owner for wording.

toni_prod: I'll review product gating and approval for enterprise-only launch. Also confirm messaging for marketing/docs.

sophia_eng: added TODOs: schema for audit events, unit/integration tests, feature-flag rollout checklist, docs snippet showing API usage and account ops flow.

noah_cs: thanks — i'll push for a procurement note to accept the interim control while we build the long-term KMS-scoped retention. :thumbsup:

sophia_eng: one risk note: need to confirm downstream systems (analytics, embeddings cache) don't rehydrate the vector into long-term storage. i'll add a verification test.

cal_legal: also note: any addendum needs a 90-day roadmap to completion for the hardened solution. we'll include that.

noah_cs: perfect. i'll follow up with HelixHealth and share the addendum draft once it's ready.
